round: Review A remediation F20: recursive backdrop resolution
green_command: CI=true pnpm --filter www-reading-advantage exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 --reporter=dot
note: All four gates exited 0 through heavy-run. The six new backdrop unit cases raise the count from 1388 to 1394. Line coverage is 91.76 percent, above the 85.52 floor and the 86.52 baseline. resolveBackdrop now walks ancestors recursively and composites each translucent layer over the resolved backdrop of its parent. An opaque layer stops the walk, a fully transparent layer is skipped, and the root falls back to the page background. A background image or a colour the parser cannot read throws with the element tag and the offending value; custom properties defined by the compiled stylesheet are resolved from that stylesheet. Foreground colour resolution stays strict. The unit test pins the composed ratio for translucent over translucent over opaque, translucent over page, gradient and unsupported colour throws, transparent skip, and opaque stop. Two production mutations, a sky-300 contact eyebrow and a slate-400 pricing title, each failed the target test with exit 1. Each production edit was restored and git status shows no production change. The commit header was shortened for the 100-character commitlint limit.
